how: Synthesized: selecting the body of a composed email (greeting, bold word, link, bullet list, small table, signature) in Outlook for Windows and copying.
notes: SYNTHESIZED. Outlook uses Word as its editor, so the HTML Format is Word-flavoured: <meta name=Generator content="Microsoft Word 15 (filtered medium)">, MsoNormal paragraphs, <div class=WordSection1>, mso-list bullets with <![if !supportLists]>, <o:p> and empty <o:p> </o:p> spacer paragraphs, a MsoNormalTable with per-cell inline borders. Unsure about extra private formats Outlook adds.
